finance.title: Tax, revenue codes and FX
finance.examplesTitle: Example rates: check them with your accountant
finance.examplesText: These taxes were filled in as examples for Lagos: service charge 10% on the room price, VAT 7.5% on the price plus service charge, and Lagos consumption tax 5% on the price. Your rates, order or authorities may differ. Change anything that is wrong, then confirm.
finance.confirmText: Set up the taxes your hotel charges, then confirm them to finish this setup step.
finance.confirm: I have checked these rates with my accountant

taxes.name: Name
taxes.authorityHint: e.g. FIRS, LIRS; "Hotel" for a service charge
taxes.inclusive: Included in the price (not added on top)
taxes.versionHint: The new rate applies from the date you choose. Charges already posted keep the tax they had.
taxes.needCode: Add a revenue code of group Tax or Service charge first.

fx.title: Exchange rates
fx.intro: What one unit of a foreign currency is worth in {{base}} for a business date. Payments in that currency use the business date’s rate (or the latest earlier one); night audit locks each day’s rates.
fx.none: No exchange rates yet: payments are taken in the base currency only.
